catalysts.headline: Bradley Heppner's criminal sentencing hearing (originally scheduled for this date before Judge Jed S. Rakoff, SDNY) was delayed indefinitely after his defense counsel (Quinn Emanuel) withdrew, citing a 'complete breakdown in communications'; he has since retained new counsel (Alexandra Shapiro, Jonathan Bach)
catalysts.impact: Sentencing did NOT occur on the date in the prior file (2026-10-21) nor on the originally scheduled 2026-10-07 date; a new sentencing date was not found in this session's searches

catalysts.headline: Beneficient announces a strategy to eliminate ~$130M in disputed HCLP Nominees debt and void Bradley Heppner's Class B equity/voting/board-appointment rights; plan would also convert ~$850M in preferred liquidation preference into ~162,132 Class A shares and void ~$88M of other obligations owed to Heppner/affiliates
catalysts.impact: Reported sharply positive stock reaction (one secondary source cited a ~194% single-day jump); plan is a proposed strategy — company states no definitive agreement has been secured yet, and it is prepared to litigate if no consensual resolution is reached

catalysts.headline: Beneficient announces strategy to eliminate HCLP debt and Heppner equity interests -- voids ~$130M disputed HCLP Nominees debt, exchanges ~$850M preferred liquidation preference for 162,132 Class A shares, and extinguishes another ~$88M in obligations; aims to end Brad Heppner's Class B super-voting/board/consent rights before his Oct 21, 2026 sentencing
catalysts.impact: stock spiked as high as +358% intraday before reversing sharply

catalysts.headline: A Manhattan federal jury convicts Bradley Heppner (Beneficient/GWG Holdings founder) on all four counts: securities fraud, wire fraud, conspiracy, and false statements to auditors
catalysts.impact: Negative overhang resolved in part — Beneficient called it a verdict that 'closes an important chapter' and said it had parted ways with Heppner upon learning of the fraud

conflicts: IMPORTANT CORRECTION to data on file: the on-file record states Heppner's sentencing was scheduled for 2026-10-21 and asks whether it occurred. The actual scheduled date found in sources was 2026-10-07 (not 10-21), and that hearing was delayed indefinitely (not held) after his counsel withdrew. No sentencing has been confirmed to have occurred as of this session's research.

Next earnings date on file (2026-10-05) is confirmed stale/wrong — that date has passed with no evidence of a report; the company's last confirmed report was 2026-08-14 (fiscal Q1 2027), and the next is estimated around mid-November 2026 (Earnings Whispers: 2026-11-13; one other aggregator's 2026-10-05 estimate is the same stale date flagged on file).

Market cap: TipRanks shows $5.05M on 9,464,248 shares outstanding, which is inconsistent with the FY2026 10-K's 14.49M Class A + 0.03M Class B share count and looks stale/wrong; disregarded in favor of the 10-K figure.

Share price: most recent quote found is $1.24 (delayed, Oct 7, 2026), down from $3.05 in July 2026 and from a 52-week high of $12.48 — consistent with Beneficient's 1-for-8 reverse split (effective Dec 15, 2025) and a subsequent severe decline (~-83% YTD per one source); no quote later than Oct 7, 2026 was found.
pendingFilings: No definitive agreement finalizing the HCLP debt elimination / Heppner Class B rights restructuring has been confirmed as filed; company says it is still pursuing this on a consensual basis as of the Sept 23, 2026 announcement.
notes: Theme 'Distressed / Restructuring' remains an excellent fit — ongoing going-concern-type issues, disputed debt, founder fraud conviction, and an active restructuring plan. The most consequential finding this session is that the Heppner sentencing date on file (Oct 21, 2026) does not match primary reporting (which points to an Oct 7, 2026 date that was itself postponed indefinitely) — this should be corrected and monitored for a new sentencing date. Cash and debt figures could not be pulled from the 10-Q this session because SEC EDGAR direct access was blocked in this sandbox and the web-search budget was exhausted before a full balance-sheet check could be completed.
